title: echinops viscosus subsp. macrolepis
intro: Echinops viscosus subsp. macrolepis, commonly known as Globe Amaranth or Velvet Flower, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Echinops viscosus subsp. macrolepis include its ability to protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
